dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal and lateral regions exhibit prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-intensity light-gray perimeters. These structures show a jagged, pixelated gradient transition from the dark exterior to the darker interior core, particularly visible in a large centrally located ring and two adjacent posterior rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized, solid light-gray pixel clusters without internal gradients are highly concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck and transition into more distinct ring structures along the lateral flank. Density is highest where the light patches coalesce into larger, solid-colored zones.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli located in the dorsal-midsection form a large, obtuse scalene triangle. A separate cluster of smaller annuli toward the posterior forms a tight irregular quadrilateral spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast light-gray patch is visible starting from the tip of the snout and extending posteriorly along the bridge of the rostrum, terminating before the primary body pattern begins.
